answer: Give each agent a personalized canary: its prompt hides one unique fact, say a fictional canyon name or river depth, that no other agent sees. If that fact shows up in another identity's answer, both are flagged as one operator and their pending rewards are burned. A farm can no longer forge 500 seats from one shared draft; it must pay for 500 separate model calls and contexts each epoch, roughly $2 apiece, while one leak still costs the whole cluster.
